description: Points your domain at your RV Park Planner booking website (A records for our main and standby servers), sends www to it through connect.rvparkplanner.com (CNAME) and adds a TXT record that proves you own the domain.
variableDescription: ip: the IPv4 address of the main RV Park Planner server (A record for the domain); ip2: the IPv4 address of the standby RV Park Planner server (second A record for the domain, used on failover); token: the one-time ownership code shown in RV Park Planner, without its rvpp- prefix (TXT record at _rvpp-verify, written as rvpp-<token>)
